nodes.label: Tiswell PWA Icon 512px
nodes.rationale: The large-size manifest icon used for install prompts and splash screens. The mark is scaled nearly edge to edge with only a thin cream margin, because the 'any' purpose contract means the platform renders the square as authored and does not crop it.

nodes.label: Opaque Cream Field Instead of Transparency
nodes.rationale: Every raster export bakes in a solid cream background even though the vector source has none. A transparent PNG would let the mark's pale sage and tan arcs disappear against a light launcher wallpaper or a light browser theme, and the palette has no dark anchor besides the small smile. Shipping the field as part of the bitmap makes contrast independent of wherever the platform places the icon.
